name: Purr Mooar

attributes.attribute: haunts the Isle of Man as an Otherworld figure

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Purr Mooar is a Manx folkloric figure. On the Isle of Man, this Otherworld spirit haunted people in the form of a pig. The being took that animal shape to trouble the people of the island.

okr.objective: Describe Purr Mooar as the pig-spirit of the Isle of Man.
key_results: Name it a Manx folkloric figure.
State it hunts people as an Otherworld spirit in pig form.
